audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gives Ziggs six of seven stages against a 46.7% win rate over 182 games — a real sample, and the packet flags the contradiction.
audit.why: Ziggs genuinely owns levels 1-4, but from level 6 Alpha Strike's untargetable dash dodges his ultimate and from Wuju Style onward true damage and Highlander's slow immunity strip his two defensive tools.
audit.corrected: win[4] and win[5] to Skill, win[6] to Master Yi, proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere and the late-game spikes were described only as 'his Highlander flank', with no mechanism.
audit.why: Alpha Strike is 20s at rank 1 and shortened by his basic attacks; Meditate is 10s; Highlander is 85s. Those three numbers are the whole scaling story.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[1], spikes[3], mid and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions are missing or backwards. (1) Alpha Strike makes him untargetable, so the page's claim that Mega Inferno Bomb is 'map-wide burst he cannot dodge' is false. (2) Highlander makes him immune to slows, which turns off Hexplosive Minefield as peel — the page's whole late-game plan. (3) Meditate is a channel, so Satchel Charge's knock-away interrupts it and denies the entire heal; that free win is never mentioned.
audit.why: The two false claims both tell a Ziggs player to trust a tool that does nothing in the exact moment he needs it.
audit.corrected: Untargetability stated in whys[4] and spikes[1]; slow immunity in whys[6], spikes[3] and late; the Meditate interrupt added to mid; Wuju Style's true damage in whys[5]; Grievous Wounds timing in late.
